description: This file defines a Flutter widget `BookCard` which displays information about a book, including its image, title, author, price, and an add-to-cart button. It interacts with provider-based state management to add the book to the shopping cart.

classes.name: BookCard
classes.description: A stateless widget representing a card UI component for displaying book information and adding the book to a shopping cart.

methods.name: build
methods.description: Builds the widget UI, displaying book image, title, author, price, and add-to-cart button.
